purpose: Proposed English caption intents for mock-first isolated-sign recognition planning.
disclaimer: These candidates are not approved SGSL signs, glosses, sign-performance instructions, or validated sign-to-caption mappings.

inputBoundary.screeningRule: Retain a candidate for a real model only after an SGSL-fluent reviewer confirms that the intended distinction is observable within the included signals and does not require an excluded signal.

candidates.handUpperBodyScreeningNotes: Common standalone greeting candidate. Confirm that an SGSL mapping is distinguishable using only the permitted two-hand and upper-body inputs and does not depend on non-manual contrast.
Standalone farewell candidate. Confirm hand/upper-body-only distinguishability and check for ambiguity with greeting concepts or reliance on conversational context.
Common social intent candidate. Confirm that the intended SGSL mapping is a standalone distinction captured by the permitted hand and upper-body inputs without required facial information.
Courtesy intent can be context-sensitive. Retain only if review identifies a standalone SGSL mapping that is distinguishable with the permitted hand and upper-body inputs alone.
Apology intent candidate. Confirm a standalone mapping, hand/upper-body-only distinguishability, and whether facial affect or other non-manual information is linguistically required.
Affirmation may include non-manual marking. Retain only if SGSL review confirms that this isolated intent has a distinct mapping observable from the permitted hand and upper-body inputs.
Negation may include non-manual marking. Retain only if SGSL review confirms that this isolated intent remains distinct without facial, mouth, gaze, or other excluded signals.
Assistance-request candidate. Confirm that a single isolated SGSL mapping supports the proposed caption intent and is distinguishable from offering help using only permitted inputs.
Meeting request candidate. Confirm that the caption intent can map to one isolated SGSL label, remains distinct from related concepts, and requires no excluded non-manual signal.
Meeting request candidate. Confirm a standalone SGSL mapping that is distinguishable from stop or stay concepts using only permitted hand and upper-body inputs.
Comprehension candidate. Confirm that the intended meaning has a standalone mapping distinguishable from know or agreement concepts within the permitted input boundary.
Completion candidate. Confirm that the proposed meaning is distinguishable from stop or end concepts using only permitted hand and upper-body inputs and without contextual inference.
